digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec (Cloud ADF + DC wiki)
propositions: Markdown structure (headings, checklists, code, lists) authored in source shows up as literal characters in Jira instead of native rich text, and rich text authored in Jira reads as noise in rebar.

Cloud ADF encoding is currently plain-text-only (one paragraph per block) and DC WikiTextCodec is an identity codec, neither performing Markdown↔format conversion, causing content loss and perpetual re-sync loops.

Existing plain-text encode and identity codec must be replaced with Markdown-aware ADF for Cloud (via marklas round-trip at 99.65% idempotence) and lossy one-way wiki renderer for DC (via pypandoc segmentation + verbatim wrap for unsafe content) while remaining echo-safe via state-based baseline comparison.

Content can erode over repeated sync passes when Jira-specific markup or ASCII tables are processed by lossy renderers without echo suppression, and concurrent edits on both sides can be silently overwritten instead of detected and flagged.
A reconcile pass producing no body changes must write zero new committed-state entries and no per-pass timestamps, maintaining stable state churn profile under the store growth discipline.

Jira-authored native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) and origin-gated outbound formatting must survive subsequent rebar-originated reconcile passes and be verifiable against live DC HTML rendering via the harness.
